title: Agents Pay $500 for This. Claude Does It Free.
description:
Comment "real estate" for the RE Walkthrough Pro skill pack

Agents pay $500 plus for one listing video.

A Zillow link does the same job.

Drop the link.
The skill pulls every photo and spec, builds the property folder.

Claude reads the images.
The Higgsfield MCP renders each scene, then stitches the full tour.

Cinematic walkthrough in minutes.
That's the unlock, fam.
